arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, subprocess, json, os, pathlib, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen2, ref, main as submain
BIN = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('TMPDIR','/workspace/tmp'))/'unit-merge-build'/'engine'
bad=0; N=700; t0=time.time()
stats={'cap':0,'mixed':0,'work':0,'pins':0,'tx':0,'acc':0,'rej':0,'stale':0}
for seed in range(N):
    req = gen2.gen_request(seed)
    exp = ref.run(req)
    data = submain.transport(req)
    res = subprocess.run([str(BIN)], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    got = json.loads(res.stdout.decode())
    if json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)!=json.dumps(exp,sort_keys=True):
        bad+=1; print('MISMATCH',seed); 
        if bad>2: break
    for s in exp['sessions']:
        for t in s['transactions']:
            stats['tx']+=1
            if t['violations'] is None: stats['stale']+=1; continue
            for i,k in enumerate(['cap','mixed','work','pins']):
                if t['violations'][i]>0: stats[k]+=1
            stats['acc' if t['accepted'] else 'rej']+=1
print('checked',N,'bad',bad,'time',round(time.time()-t0,1)); print(stats)
EOF
